scope: Transient lyric-range practice using the existing native audio player

testFirst.observedBeforeProductEdits: Root inspected one expected missing #practice-first failure after a genuine original WAV project and loaded native audio; 10047.028 ms total.
testFirst.excludedFromRedEvidence: An earlier wrong-grep no-tests result is separate and is not feature RED.

behavior: First and last selectors retain explicit ordered inclusive cue indices; a new usable clip defaults to line 1 through line 1. Reversed or invalid selections refuse without clamping.
Exact source endpoints and every intermediate instrumental gap appear in the range summary. Current Original, Vocals or Backing is identified in both the summary and preview footer.
Play once, Repeat range and existing Play line share the same bounded native-player controller at normal 1x speed without native looping.
Seek and play admission share a ten-second deadline. Per-operation ownership cancels pending listeners, deadlines and animation-frame work. Practice does not overwrite audio.onloadedmetadata.
Every start captures project, loaded-project generation, edit generation, media generation, track, source, duration, epoch, range and mode.
Pause invalidates pending admission and retains the selected range; Resume is explicit. Stop clears ownership before pausing and keeps the current playhead.

Ordinary media boundary observation checks actual time before interpreting native pause at natural end. Explicit Pause takes precedence over repeat and its queued native pause event cannot resume the range.

Raw title, pasted text or cue input retires ownership in the capture phase, before mutation. Undo/Redo, cue actions, timeline gestures/seek, file choices, SRT application, track/project changes, Save, deletion, media jobs and timing capture also retire practice.
Practice retires before track() captures ordinary playback intent, preserving ordinary track-switch playback while preventing a retired practice session from resuming on another track.
External seeking, playback-rate changes, native source/error changes, hidden-page and pagehide retire ownership without automatic return. Late play fulfillment/rejection is inert after retirement.

Practice UI updates do not rebuild lyric rows, call changed(), record history, alter dirty/video state, save revisions or modify audio. Valid unsaved cue edits may be practiced; unapplied paste remains excluded and intact.

precision.authoredEndpoints: Retained and requested exactly; no rounding or range expansion.
precision.ownedSeekAdmissionPurpose: Only identify a matching completed native seek despite media-clock quantization. A matching undershoot remains in starting phase until actual forward playback reaches the exact source start.
precision.endDecision: Strict domain boundary using actual native time, without the seek allowance. At genuine natural media end only, the existing one-sample PCM duration admission allows the exact project endpoint.

review.kind: Independent read-only source review before integrated native execution
review.finding: Explicit Pause could race a repeat endpoint and start the next repetition.
review.correction: Pause now establishes paused ownership before native pause; a queued paused event preserves this intent. Explicit Resume handles the reached endpoint deliberately through the same boundary path, including its existing genuine native-end duration admission.

producerDefectsAndCorrections.observed: Play line preservation case could not find the exact accessible name Play line 2 within the unchanged five-second expectation.
producerDefectsAndCorrections.cause: The inherited label expression duplicated the word line: Play line line 2.
producerDefectsAndCorrections.correction: Only Play line now produces Play line N; all other existing action labels remain unchanged.

producerDefectsAndCorrections.observed: Controlled hidden lifecycle case left #practice-once disabled after visibility returned and native pause had settled.
producerDefectsAndCorrections.cause: Hidden retirement refreshed disabled controls, but the later visible visibilitychange did not refresh explicit admission controls.
producerDefectsAndCorrections.correction: Visible visibilitychange refreshes practice controls only; it does not create an owner, seek, play or resume. Existing hidden retirement remains intact.
